authority.direct_user_request: 可以，你自己决定，计划V0.9吧，然后我们需要逐渐放权，以及让反馈更加有效果，以及提高训练次数
authority.this_turn: Choose and save a usable research plan, not train.
authority.normal_implementation_decisions: Assistant decides within declared scientific and resource scope; no repeated procedural confirmation.
authority.old_evidence: Preserve V0.3-V0.8; no old native, fixture or checker reruns.

hypothesis: Conditional own-history use and uncertainty-triggered multi-step factual readout may improve learning efficiency in partially observed spatial pursuit under equal real interaction budgets.

interpretation.unit: Four complete learning systems, not isolated proof of attribution itself.
interpretation.pure_feedback: No externally supplied scalar reward/penalty training channel; supervised factual prediction plus explicit task-goal planning. Internal goal utility exists and overlaps conceptually with model-based RL.
interpretation.autonomy: Gradual access to retrieval and bounded lookahead; action selection and prediction are model driven. Retrieval metric, scheduler heuristic, external task goals and budgets remain designer specified.
uncertainties: Factual model error and compounding multi-step error
Punishment changes the training objective, not guaranteed same optimal policy
More difficult maps do not guarantee larger feedback benefits

environment.mix: Every block of 16 episode starts covers all 8 train maps x 2 conditions; same initial-source order across arms. Mix does not change with autonomy stage.
environment.monster_spawn: Road on first hero FOV boundary; if none, roads at Chebyshev distance >=8; one draw from fixed candidate list, not effect search
environment.move_mask: 0-7 always available, not equivalent to collision-free

monster_policy.ties: External coordinate random; no agent kernel query

environment.step_order: Hero motion/path collection, capture check, monsters in ID order with per-substep capture checks, cooldown update and observation.
environment.flash_capture: Hero-stage capture at landing only; collect along traversed path; no legal landing still consumes cooldown.
environment.observation: Own position, step/remaining time, 21x21 visible terrain/items, visible monster facts, outside-view relative direction/distance buckets, cooldown/speed and 16 legal actions
prohibited_inputs: Hidden map ID/seed as retrieval keys
environment.atlas: Episode-local, from actual observations only; reset each real/eval episode. Cross-episode reuse via own raw history and learned parameters.

arms.name: 纯强化学习
arms.learning: Recurrent Double-DQN + real replay and common history interface

arms.name: 反馈＋奖惩
arms.learning: Common recurrent Q + own factual model and planner readout

arms.name: 反馈＋仅奖励
arms.learning: Same as F-RP except capture penalty

common_capabilities.independent_model_initialization_pairs: Q components matched across the three Q arms; factual components matched across three factual arms; shared spec, never shared mutable state
common_capabilities.raw_history_access: Same capacity/interface across all arms; each owns only its own real history; FIFO runtime eviction with original external capture preserved.

autonomy_stages.permission: Full physical action choice; ordinary learning; factual arms H=1
Common conditional own-history retrieval; factual correction need not wait for Q tie
Data-triggered optional H=1/4/8 lookahead in feedback arms

learning.backend: Small recurrent Double-DQN for Q arms; own factual predictors for F0 and hybrids. New local CPU PyTorch runtime.
learning.factual_update_schedule: Same real-step schedule and real-sequence batch size; three factual heads trained on self-owned observed targets, not hidden facts. Extra work counted.
supervised_targets: Observed future surviving steps and pickups for F0 tail facts
learning.missing_target_policy: Mask unobserved monster truth and incomplete future tails; never zero-fill them as failures.
learning.terminal_bootstrap: No bootstrap beyond completed finite task horizon or capture; administrative cuts treated separately.
learning.network_versions: Pin actual dependency versions and source before first execution, not claimed installed now.

retrieval.distance: Fixed observable-context distance; no evaluator labels or effect-selected records

feedback.uncertainty: Empirical head disagreement and prequential own-outcome error; not a guaranteed calibrated confidence set
feedback.history_policy: Keep contradictory success/failure observations; no global permanent action bans.
feedback.prequential: Prediction emitted before actual outcome and before fitting that outcome.
feedback.suffixes: Own current policy/prediction, no hardcoded route
feedback.trigger: Head argmax disagreement OR top-two score margin below median prequential cumulative-outcome prediction error in the same score units; <64 completed errors means uncertain. Never compare Brier probability error directly with Q margin.
feedback.unknown_terrain: Stop simulated local branch with unknown marker and own tail estimate, without reading true map or banning real exploration.
feedback.readout_F0: Task utility of predicted factual survival/pickups; no external scalar-reward loss.
feedback.readout_hybrid: Predicted rewards for that arm plus tail Q estimate; no current-Q-tie prerequisite.
feedback.meta_policy_limit: The stopping/retrieval rules are specified heuristics, not a learned general feedback-value allocator.

matrix.actual_train_episode_count: Outcome-dependent; report actual rather than asserting a fixed episode count.
matrix.evaluation_split: Half seen, half held-out; inside each split equal solo/duo and map weight.

ablations.source: Balanced 128-episode subset of each model's final main bank; same coordinates across variants.
ablations.no_retrieval_limit: Weights may still encode past experience; episode-local observation memory remains usable.

evaluation.primary_condition: seen train-map duo, macro-average fixed maps within seed
evaluation.primary_auc: Trapezoid over all fixed training-step checkpoints, divide by 262144

target.label: Auxiliary first observed crossing, interval-uncertain labels and later regressions retained

evaluation.inference_unit: 64 paired independent training seeds; episodes/maps are nested, not independent training replicates
evaluation.family_claim: Descriptive paired intervals, no full-family PASS or equivalence from non-significance

randomness.engines: Local Python/NumPy/PyTorch, versions pinned on implementation
randomness.pairing: Environment coordinate does not contain arm; keyed by scenario episode/step/entity/substep. Arm-dependent second-monster position is a causal consequence, not a forced shared absolute state.

engineering.scope: Throughput/interfaces/recording only; no effect-based choice of maps, seeds, reward or algorithm parameters.

observed_machine.display_GPU: Intel Arc; no usable CUDA device confirmed

budget.dependency_policy: Use isolated new local environment, official CPU PyTorch packages; no modification of old runtime. No package installed this turn.
budget.resource_action: Profile before main matrix; optimize mathematically equivalent batching/capture. If still over budget, report concrete cost/partial honestly; do not silently shrink N or extend to positive findings.
budget.capture: Compact real step actions/events/random coordinates plus complete checkpoints and learning/update references; no full model/map duplication each step.
budget.failure_resume: Keep failed/partial capture; version repairs. Resume only unexecuted suffix with complete saved state. Do not silently replay executed prefix.

completion: Four paths actually learn and are measured under stated scope, report efficiency, costs and limitations; positive, zero or negative results accepted. No requirement to dominate all maps or show general taste.
next_implementation: Local environment and shared observable/history interface, then four real learning paths and finite engineering profile, then fixed main matrix.
